title: Low-pass RC circuit design and frequency response
aim: To construct passive RC low-pass filters, measure frequency response, and determine cutoff frequency.

theory.summary: Passive RC filters use resistors and capacitors to attenuate high frequencies while passing low frequencies. The cutoff frequency fc is the frequency at which the output voltage drops to 70.7% (-3dB) of the input voltage.

procedure: Step 1: Connect resistor in series with function generator, capacitor in parallel with CRO.
Step 2: Set input amplitude to 2V peak-to-peak and vary frequency from 10Hz to 100kHz.
Step 3: Measure output and determine cutoff frequency.

observations.what_to_plot: Gain in dB vs Log Frequency

common_errors.symptom: Output equals input at all frequencies
causes: CRO probe connected to input instead of output

viva_questions.q: What is the roll-off rate of single-stage RC?

title: Single-stage amplifier frequency response
aim: To plot the frequency response of a single-stage Common Emitter BJT amplifier and determine bandwidth.

theory.summary: A common emitter BJT amplifier provides high voltage and current gain. High-pass coupling/bypass capacitors limit gain at low frequencies, while transistor junction capacitance limits gain at high frequencies.

procedure: Step 1: Set up CE bias configuration with R1, R2, Rc, and Re.
Step 2: Connect input AC signal of 10mV peak-to-peak through coupling capacitor.
Step 3: Measure output voltage across Rc as frequency is swept from 20Hz to 1MHz.

observations.what_to_plot: Gain in dB vs Log Frequency

expected_results.description: Gain should remain constant in mid-band (~150 V/V) and drop off at low/high frequency limits.

causes: Bypass capacitor CE is open or disconnected
common_errors.fix: Verify that CE is firmly connected across Re to bypass AC currents to ground.

viva_questions.q: What is the phase shift in a CE amplifier?

title: RC Phase Shift Oscillator
aim: To design and test an RC phase-shift oscillator using an op-amp and verify Barkhausen criteria.

theory.summary: An RC phase-shift oscillator uses a cascade of three 60-degree feedback RC stages to provide 180 degrees shift, combined with inverting op-amp phase inversion (180 degrees).

procedure: Step 1: Set up inverting amplifier with LM741.
Step 2: Connect three-stage RC ladder in feedback loop from pin 6 back to pin 2.
Step 3: Adjust Rf pot until sinusoids appear on CRO.

common_errors.fix: Increase Rf potentiometer resistance to exceed gain of 29.

viva_questions.q: What is loop gain at oscillation?

title: Wien Bridge Oscillator
aim: To design and test a Wien Bridge oscillator and verify gain requirements.

theory.summary: Wien Bridge oscillators use a lead-lag feedback bandpass network providing zero phase shift at resonance (attenuation β = 1/3), requiring non-inverting gain of at least 3.

procedure: Step 1: Set up non-inverting gain loop with Rf pot.
Step 2: Connect series RC from output to pin 3, and parallel RC from pin 3 to ground.
Step 3: Vary Rf pot until oscillations sustain.

causes: Lead-lag connected to wrong input pin
common_errors.fix: Ensure positive feedback connects to pin 3, not pin 2.

viva_questions.q: What is feedback factor at resonance?
